pages.title: Target Selection
pages.text: self selects the owner. target selects the event victim or keyword bearer. nearby selects entities around center self or target. aim selects along the owner view. radius controls range; limit bounds affected entities.

pages.title: Nearby Safety
pages.text: Nearby targeting defaults to excluding allies and players. Enable include_allies or include_players deliberately for buffs or PvP. Radius is at most 64 blocks; limit is at most 64 entities. A script can combine several differently targeted actions.

pages.title: Damage and Healing
pages.text: damage specifies amount and an element or school. damage_fraction adds a fraction of the triggering hit. heal restores amount and defaults to holy scaling. per_rank scales with the owning skill rank; per_stack scales with keyword stacks. An explicit element can name a custom damage type.

pages.title: Potion Effects
pages.text: effect uses a registered mob effect, duration in ticks, and amplifier. Amplifier 0 is level I; 1 is level II. Effects can target the player, victim, or selected nearby entities.

pages.title: Spells
pages.text: spell chooses an installed Iron spell ID and level. It runs one native activation with target-facing aim, without spending mana, cooldown, or an unlock. The trigger supplies chance and cooldown. Native preconditions still apply; continuous spells are one activation, not a held channel.

pages.title: Lightning and Particles
pages.text: lightning creates the strike presentation and controlled damage amount. particles uses a simple particle ID, count, spread, and speed. Examples are minecraft:flame, minecraft:explosion, and minecraft:electric_spark. Parameterized particles such as dust are not accepted.

pages.title: Keyword Actions
pages.text: keyword adds stacks, optionally overriding duration. remove_keyword subtracts stacks; zero removes all. Applying a keyword refreshes its lifetime. Combine these with conditional actions to transform or consume effects.
